summary: Strong PowerShell workflow + module design. Proper use of Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference, quoted variables, approved verbs, and XML doc comments throughout. YAML uses pinned actions (v4), least-privilege permissions, and correct `shell: pwsh` instead of command-line invocation. Module architecture is testable (Resolve-PackageLicense seam, offline-first with LicenseDatabase param). Excellent comments explaining design rationale. Minor: act output capture in run-act-tests.ps1 could be more robust (2>&1 piped to Out-String may lose stderr context); magic strings like 'Approved'/'Denied'/'Unknown' aren't constants; manifest regex patterns are terse. Overall very solid and shippable.
